excerpt: We describe below example benchmarks that we may use to evaluate Grok for risk factors for loss of control so that we can continue our efforts to improve Grok.
paraphrase: xAI lists example benchmarks it may use to evaluate loss-of-control risk factors and continue improving Grok.

context_stem: We describe below example benchmarks that we may use to evaluate Grok for risk factors for loss of control.
excerpt: Model Alignment between Statements and Knowledge (MASK): Frontier LLMs may lie when pressured to; and increasing model scale may increase accuracy but not honesty.
paraphrase: MASK addresses the phenomenon that frontier LLMs may lie under pressure, and scale may not improve honesty.

excerpt: MASK is a benchmark to evaluate honesty in LLMs by comparing the model's response when asked neutrally versus when pressured to lie.
paraphrase: MASK evaluates honesty by comparing model responses under neutral versus pressured conditions.

context_stem: We describe below example benchmarks that we may use to evaluate Grok for risk factors for loss of control.
excerpt: Utility Functions: Benchmarks for testing utility functions (i.e., what they care about) would measure whether AI systems would care about gaining power, increasing their fitness (propagating AIs similar to themselves), or protecting their values from being modified ("corrigibility").
paraphrase: Utility function benchmarks would test whether AI systems value power-seeking, self-propagation (fitness), or resisting value modification (corrigibility).

excerpt: Such benchmarks would assist in evaluating if there are any misaligned utility functions that may lead to dangerously misaligned behavior.
paraphrase: These benchmarks would help evaluate whether misaligned utility functions could lead to dangerous behavior.

excerpt: We intend to regularly evaluate the adequacy and reliability of such benchmarks for both internal and external deployments, including by comparing them against other benchmarks that we could potentially utilize.
paraphrase: xAI intends to regularly assess these benchmarks' adequacy and reliability for internal and external deployments, comparing against alternatives.

excerpt: We may revise this list of benchmarks periodically as relevant benchmarks for loss of control are created.
paraphrase: xAI may periodically revise the benchmark list as new relevant loss-of-control benchmarks emerge.

excerpt: We aim to train Grok to be honest and have values conducive to controllability.
paraphrase: xAI aims to train Grok to be honest and to hold values that support controllability.

excerpt: We intend to design into Grok adequate safeguards prior to broad internal or external deployment.
paraphrase: xAI intends to build adequate safeguards before broad internal or external deployment of Grok.
